## Context / Problem
When an egress proxy refuses a gate LLM request by policy, the failure classifier labels it "Transient connection blip — retry immediately" (RETRY_NOW, exit 11). Retrying cannot succeed: the refusal is a fixed proxy policy, not a blip.

Observed 2026-11-22 21:44 PST: `review-plan antiviral-agrarian-amurminnow` run inside the Claude Code Bash sandbox without `api.anthropic.com` in the command's allowed hosts returned INDETERMINATE with `llm-degrade: RETRY_NOW — Transient connection blip`. The FallbackModel sub-exceptions, captured by wrapping `run_failure.interpret_failure` around a single-turn `get_runner(resolve_gate_config(".")).run(...)` call, were for both candidates: `ModelAPIError(Connection error.) <- anthropic.APIConnectionError <- httpx.ProxyError("403 not in this command's allowed_domains ...") <- httpcore.ProxyError`. The same probe with `api.anthropic.com` allowed returned a completion. So the LLM transport does route through the proxy (the c8118c62e81 fix works); only the classification is wrong.

Cause in code: `src/rebar/llm/failure.py::_map` has no arm for `httpx.ProxyError`; the wrapped `ModelAPIError` without a status code falls to the final `ModelAPIError -> RETRY_NOW` arm, and the fallback-group classifier lets any retryable leg win.

## Approach
Reproduced 2026-11-23 PST on gerrit main 053604a2618: a `ModelAPIError` <- `anthropic.APIConnectionError` <- `httpx.ProxyError("403 not in this command's allowed_domains")` chain, alone and as both legs of a `FallbackExceptionGroup`, classifies `RETRY_NOW`, retryable (exit 11), message "Transient connection blip", diagnostic `{'exception_type': 'FallbackExceptionGroup', 'message': 'All models from FallbackModel failed (2 sub-exceptions)'}` with no proxy mention.

Root cause: `httpx.ProxyError` is a `TransportError`, not a `ConnectError`, so no httpx arm in `src/rebar/llm/failure.py::_map` matches. The wrapping `ModelAPIError` (no status code) reaches the final `ModelAPIError -> RETRY_NOW` arm, and `_classify_fallback_group` lets any retryable leg win. httpcore raises `ProxyError("<status> <reason>")` when a proxy answers CONNECT with a non-2xx status. A 4xx answer is the proxy's policy (allowlist refusal, 407 auth required), so retrying cannot help.

Fix, all in `src/rebar/llm/failure.py`:
1. `_proxy_refusal(exc) -> str | None`: walks `exc` and its `__cause__`/`__context__` chain (bounded, cycle-safe). It returns the proxy's text when it finds an `httpx.ProxyError` whose message starts with a 4xx status, and `None` otherwise. A proxy 5xx (e.g. 502 while the upstream is unreachable) and a raw `ConnectError`/`ConnectTimeout` are not refusals and keep today's classes.
2. The tail of `_map` (the `ModelAPIError -> RETRY_NOW` arm and the `NEEDS_INVESTIGATION` default) moves into a helper `_map_tail(exc, ModelAPIError)` that returns `CHANGE_SETTINGS` first when `_proxy_refusal(exc)` finds a refusal. The proxy allowlist or proxy credentials is a setting, the class whose remedy is "check settings, then retry", and it is non-retryable. Extracting the tail keeps `_map`'s complexity at or below today's 14.
3. `_classify_fallback_group`: a retryable leg still wins, as today. Otherwise, when every leg is a proxy refusal, the group is `CHANGE_SETTINGS`, not `CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL`, because switching model or provider behind the same proxy does not help.
4. Diagnostic: `_base_diagnostic` sets the allowlisted `error_type` to `proxy_refused` and appends the proxy's own text (passed through the existing redactor) to `message` when the exception, or every leg of a group, is a proxy refusal.
5. Message: a `PROXY_REFUSED_MESSAGE` specialization, parallel to `CONTENT_FILTER_MESSAGE`. `message_for(..., error_type=None)` returns it for `CHANGE_SETTINGS` with `error_type == "proxy_refused"`, naming the HTTP proxy refusal (a fixed policy, not a transient fault) and the remedy (allow the provider host through the proxy, or run where it is allowed). The 3 callers (`src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py` x2, `src/rebar/_commands/completion_verifier_run.py`) pass `diagnostic.get("error_type")`. The new keyword is optional, so existing callers are unchanged. No config key, env var or flag is added.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/llm/failure.py`, `src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/completion_verifier_run.py`
- `tests/unit/test_llm_proxy_refusal.py` (new)

## Testing
New `tests/unit/test_llm_proxy_refusal.py`, building real exception chains (`ModelAPIError` <- `anthropic.APIConnectionError` <- `httpx.ProxyError` <- `httpcore.ProxyError`):
- Single leg with a 403 refusal: `CHANGE_SETTINGS`, `retryable` False, diagnostic `error_type == "proxy_refused"` with the proxy text in `message`. `message_for` names the proxy refusal and is not the RETRY_NOW text.
- The same chain as both legs of a `FallbackExceptionGroup`: `CHANGE_SETTINGS`, non-retryable, the proxy message (the AC test). A 407 refusal is also non-retryable.
- Edge cases: a group with one proxy-refused leg and one throttled `ModelHTTPError` 429 leg stays `WAIT_AND_RETRY` (a retryable leg still wins); a group with one proxy-refused leg and one 401 leg stays `CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL`; a proxy 502 `ProxyError` chain keeps `RETRY_NOW`; a raw `httpx.ProxyError` 403 is `CHANGE_SETTINGS`; a self-referential `__cause__` cycle terminates.
- Unchanged: `httpx.ConnectError` and `httpx.ConnectTimeout`, alone and wrapped, keep `RETRY_NOW`; a plain `ModelAPIError` keeps `RETRY_NOW`. The existing classifier, disposition and fallback-chain test files keep passing.
- The new tests fail on the pre-fix code (verified by running them against it), and `make verify` passes before push.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A gate LLM failure whose cause chain holds an `httpx.ProxyError` from a proxy refusal (CONNECT answered with a 4xx) is not classified RETRY_NOW or WAIT_AND_RETRY, and its surfaced message names the proxy refusal.
- [ ] A unit test builds that cause chain (ModelAPIError <- APIConnectionError <- httpx.ProxyError 403) inside a FallbackExceptionGroup and asserts the non-retryable class; existing ConnectError/ConnectTimeout cases keep RETRY_NOW.
